title: CUTM Ranks Among Top 100 Universities in NIRF 2026
summary: Centurion University secured an All-India Rank of 87 in NIRF 2026, reflecting excellence in teaching, research, and industry outreach.
content:
Centurion University of Technology and Management has achieved its best-ever NIRF ranking, securing an All-India Rank of 87 in the National Institutional Ranking Framework 2026 released by the Ministry of Education.

The university performed strongly across all five parameters — Teaching, Learning & Resources, Research and Professional Practice, Graduation Outcomes, Outreach and Inclusivity, and Perception.

"This is a proud moment for every student, faculty member, and staff at CUTM. The ranking reflects our collective commitment to quality education and meaningful research," said Vice-Chancellor Prof. Shubhanshu Shekhar Pathak.

CUTM also featured among the Top 50 universities in Odisha and the Top 10 private universities in Eastern India. Over 120 research papers from CUTM were published in Scopus-indexed journals in 2025 alone.
author: Editorial Desk

title: Convocation 2026: 2,400 Students Receive Degrees in Grand Ceremony
summary: CUTM's 14th Annual Convocation was held with the Governor of Odisha as Chief Guest. Gold medals were awarded to 28 rank holders across departments.
content:
Centurion University held its 14th Annual Convocation Ceremony on Saturday, with the Honourable Governor of Odisha presiding as Chief Guest. A total of 2,400 graduating students received their degrees across undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes.

Gold medals were awarded to 28 rank holders across departments including Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Agriculture, and Law. The President's Gold Medal for the Best All-Round Student was awarded to Ms. Priyanka Mahapatra of the CSE department.

Vice-Chancellor Prof. Pathak presented the annual report, highlighting a 94% placement rate for the 2025 batch and over 150 research publications.
author: Campus Reporter

title: CUTM Students Bag 47 Offers in Infosys Campus Drive
summary: The Placement Cell completed a mega campus recruitment drive with Infosys, offering packages of ₹3.6 LPA to 47 final-year students from CS, IT, and ECE branches.
content:
The CUTM Placement Cell concluded a successful campus recruitment drive with Infosys Limited, resulting in 47 job offers to final-year students from CSE, IT, and ECE departments.

Selected students will join Infosys as Systems Engineers with a package of ₹3.6 Lakhs Per Annum. Additionally, 12 students were selected for the Infosys Power Programmer track at ₹8 LPA, reserved for students with exceptional coding scores.

The Placement Cell has facilitated 340 offers from 35 companies this season, including TCS, Wipro, Capgemini, L&T Technology Services, and Mindtree. The drive season continues through July.
author: Placement Cell

title: CENTURION FEST 2026: Three Days of Culture, Talent and Energy
summary: CUTM's flagship annual cultural festival returns with 60+ events including music, dance, drama, hackathons, and robotics competitions across three campuses.
content:
Centurion Fest 2026 kicked off on Friday with an electric opening ceremony at the main ground in Paralakhemundi, attended by 8,000 students from across all campuses.

The three-day festival features over 60 events spanning classical and contemporary dance, music battles, street plays, stand-up comedy, fashion shows, and technical competitions like hackathons and robotics challenges.

The technical flagship — HackCentury 2026 — attracted 180 teams from 35 colleges across Odisha and Andhra Pradesh, competing for prizes totalling ₹2.5 lakhs. Problem statements focus on AgriTech, HealthTech, and Smart Governance.
author: Student Affairs Desk

title: CUTM Cricket Team Wins Inter-University Tournament in Bhubaneswar
summary: The CUTM men's cricket team clinched the Odisha Inter-University Cricket Trophy 2026, defeating Utkal University in the final by 6 wickets at KIIT Stadium.
content:
The Centurion University cricket team brought home the Odisha Inter-University Cricket Trophy 2026 after a commanding 6-wicket victory over Utkal University in the final played at KIIT Cricket Stadium, Bhubaneswar.

Captain Subhrajit Sahoo (68 not out) guided the team home with 14 balls to spare. Bowler Praveen Rao was named Man of the Match for his earlier spell of 4 wickets for 32 runs that restricted Utkal to a manageable total.

Dean of Students Affairs Dr. Bijaya Mahapatra announced a special scholarship for all 15 squad members. The team will now represent Odisha at the All India Inter-University Cricket Tournament in September.
author: Sports Desk

title: School of Engineering Launches New B.Tech in AI & Data Science
summary: CUTM introduces a new 4-year B.Tech programme in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science from 2026-27, with 60 seats and an industry-embedded curriculum.
content:
Centurion University's School of Engineering will offer a new B.Tech programme in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science from the academic year 2026-27, designed in collaboration with TCS iON, IBM, and the National Informatics Centre.

The four-year programme has an intake of 60 students. What makes this programme unique is its industry-embedded model: students will spend their 6th semester at a company partner's facility for live project work, earning both academic credits and a stipend.

An optional international exchange semester is available with partner universities in Germany and Singapore. Admissions open from July 1 through the CUTM Direct Admission portal.
author: Academic Affairs

title: CUTM Researcher Develops Low-Cost Water Purification System for Rural Areas
summary: Dr. Sanjib Panda from Civil Engineering has developed a solar-powered water purification unit that serves 500 households at just ₹40,000.
content:
A research team led by Dr. Sanjib Panda, Associate Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering, has developed a low-cost solar-powered water purification system for rural communities in Odisha.

The system, branded SujalTech, uses biosand filtration, UV disinfection, and activated charcoal to remove 99.8% of pathogens and heavy metals. A single unit purifies 5,000 litres per day — sufficient for approximately 500 households — at a total cost of just ₹40,000.

The prototype has been deployed in 3 villages in Gajapati district and has received a patent filing from the university's IP Cell. Three NGOs have expressed interest in the system for community-level deployment.
author: Research & Innovation Cell

title: Student Anjali Devi Wins National-Level Debate Competition in Delhi
summary: Third-year Law student Anjali Devi won the All India Inter-University Debate Championship at JNU, New Delhi, beating 94 participants from 47 universities.
content:
Anjali Devi, a third-year student of the School of Law at CUTM, won the prestigious All India Inter-University Debate Championship 2026 held at Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi, beating 94 participants from 47 universities across the country.

The competition topic was "Uniform Civil Code: Necessity or Imposition?" Anjali was praised by judges for her analytical depth, composure under pressure, and command of constitutional jurisprudence.

Anjali will receive the Chancellor's Award for Academic Excellence at the upcoming semester prize distribution. She is also scheduled to represent India at the South Asia Law Students Forum in Colombo in August.
author: Student Affairs Desk

title: International MoU Signed with University of Groningen, Netherlands
summary: CUTM signed a bilateral MoU with the University of Groningen for student and faculty exchange, joint research, and co-publication programmes starting 2026.
content:
Centurion University signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the University of Groningen, Netherlands — one of Europe's oldest and most prestigious universities — establishing collaboration in student exchange, faculty exchange, joint research, and dual-degree programme development in Sustainability, AgriTech, and Computer Science.

Vice-Chancellor Prof. Pathak and University of Groningen's Director of International Relations Prof. Jan Willem Schoutens signed the agreement at a ceremony at the CUTM main campus.

This is CUTM's 11th international MoU. Applications for the 2027 exchange programme will open in October 2026.
author: International Relations Office

title: CUTM Alumni Rajeev Kumar Joins as VP Engineering at Microsoft India
summary: CUTM 2013 alumnus Rajeev Kumar has been appointed Vice President – Engineering at Microsoft India, a remarkable milestone for a Centurion graduate.
content:
Rajeev Kumar, a 2013 alumnus of CUTM's B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, has been appointed as Vice President – Engineering at Microsoft India, marking one of the highest corporate positions reached by a CUTM graduate to date.

Rajeev joined CUTM in 2009 and was known for his passion for competitive programming. After graduating with distinction, he joined Microsoft as a Software Development Engineer and steadily rose through the ranks over 13 years.

Rajeev has already expressed interest in supporting a Microsoft campus hiring programme at CUTM. The Alumni Association database now tracks over 18,000 graduates globally.
author: Alumni Relations Office

title: Annual Sports Meet 'Centurion Games 2026' Concludes with Record Participation
summary: The week-long inter-department sports meet saw 1,800 students compete in 22 disciplines. School of Engineering topped the overall trophy tally.
content:
The Centurion Games 2026, CUTM's annual inter-department sports meet, concluded after seven days of competition across 22 sports disciplines involving 1,800 student athletes.

The School of Engineering and Technology topped the overall medal tally, winning 34 medals (14 gold, 11 silver, 9 bronze). Standout performances included Suresh Behera breaking the university 100m sprint record at 10.8 seconds.

The basketball finals between the School of Law and the School of Nursing attracted the largest crowd of the meet, with Law winning 62-58 in overtime.
author: Sports Desk

title: CUTM Launches Centre of Excellence in Cybersecurity with DSCI Partnership
summary: The new CoE in Cybersecurity with the Data Security Council of India will train 500 students annually in ethical hacking, digital forensics, and cloud security.
content:
CUTM inaugurated its Centre of Excellence in Cybersecurity in partnership with the Data Security Council of India (DSCI), equipped with a dedicated cyber range featuring 50 workstations with industry-standard tools including Kali Linux, Wireshark, Metasploit, and IBM QRadar SIEM.

The centre will train 500 students annually and offer certification programmes in Ethical Hacking, Digital Forensics, Cloud Security, and SOC Analyst tracks. DSCI will provide internship and placement support through its network of over 300 companies.
author: Research & Innovation Cell

title: End Semester Examinations Schedule Released for June–July 2026
summary: The Controller of Examinations has released the timetable. Exams begin June 20 and conclude July 15. Admit cards available from June 12.
content:
The Office of the Controller of Examinations has published the official timetable for End Semester Examinations for the June–July 2026 cycle. Examinations will commence from June 20, 2026 and conclude on July 15, 2026.

  • Admit card download opens: June 12
  • Theory examinations begin: June 20
  • Last examination: July 15
  • Result declaration (tentative): August 10

Students with exam-related grievances must report to the Examination Section by June 14. No requests will be entertained after that date.
author: Examination Cell

title: CUTM Wins Best University in Skill Education Award at National EdTech Summit
summary: The university received the 'Best University for Skill-Integrated Education 2026' award at the National Education and Technology Summit in New Delhi.
content:
Centurion University was honoured with the 'Best University for Skill-Integrated Education 2026' award at the National Education and Technology Summit held at Vigyan Bhavan, New Delhi.

CUTM's unique credit-based skill curriculum ensures that every graduate is proficient in at least one vocational skill — from solar panel installation and drone operation to accounting software and digital marketing.

CUTM is also the nodal institution for PMKVY in Southern Odisha, having trained over 45,000 youth in various skill programmes since 2016.
author: PR & Communications Cell

title: Guest Lecture: NASA Scientist Dr. Priya Nair Speaks on Space Exploration
summary: Over 600 students attended an inspiring guest lecture by NASA Research Scientist Dr. Priya Nair on the future of space exploration and aerospace careers.
content:
The School of Engineering hosted a guest lecture by Dr. Priya Nair, Research Scientist at NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory, who delivered a talk titled "Beyond Earth: The Next Frontier of Human Space Exploration" to an audience of over 600 students and faculty.

Dr. Nair, a Bhubaneswar native, spoke about her journey from a small-town student to working on Mars rover missions at NASA. She shared insights on the Perseverance rover, the Artemis moon programme, and plans for a crewed Mars mission.

Dr. Nair has agreed to be a guest mentor for CUTM's Aerospace Club going forward.
author: Events Desk

title: 25 CUTM Students Selected for Google Summer of Code 2026
summary: A record 25 students from CUTM have been selected as GSoC 2026 contributors — the highest from any single university in Eastern India.
content:
A record 25 students from Centurion University have been selected as contributors in Google Summer of Code 2026, the highest from any single university in Eastern India and a dramatic rise from 8 selections in 2025.

Selected students will work with organisations including Mozilla, TensorFlow, OpenCV, Apache Software Foundation, and Wikimedia Foundation, earning stipends ranging from $1,500 to $3,300.

The GSoC team at CUTM is led by the Open Source Club, which has been running weekly coding sessions, mock interviews, and proposal-writing workshops since January.
author: Technology Desk

title: New Hostel Block with 800 Beds Inaugurated at Paralakhemundi Campus
summary: Girls' Hostel Block D and Boys' Hostel Block F were inaugurated by the Chancellor, adding 800 beds with modern amenities to the main campus.
content:
The Paralakhemundi main campus of CUTM welcomed two new hostel blocks — Girls' Hostel Block D and Boys' Hostel Block F — inaugurated by Chancellor Sri Manoj Nayak.

Each six-storey block accommodates 400 residents with attached bathrooms, 24-hour hot water, high-speed Wi-Fi, a study hall, and a mess that can serve 500 students per sitting. The blocks were constructed in 18 months at a cost of ₹28 crore.

Allotment for the 2026-27 academic year will begin through the student portal from June 20, with priority given to first-year students.
author: Administration Desk

title: Agriculture Students Win First Prize at National Agri-Innovation Challenge
summary: A team of five students developed a drone-based precision fertiliser system and won the top prize at the national competition in Pune.
content:
A team of five students from CUTM's School of Agriculture won the First Prize at the National Agri-Innovation Challenge 2026 held at MANAGE in Pune.

The team developed PreciDrone, an autonomous drone equipped with multispectral sensors that identifies nutrient deficiency zones and dispenses fertiliser only where needed, reducing fertiliser use by up to 40%.

The prize carries a cash award of ₹2 lakh, a commercialisation grant, and a 6-month incubation opportunity at the Pune Agritech Hub. The team has already filed for a patent with the university's IP Cell.
author: Research & Innovation Cell
